name: Jane Smith
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Full-stack software engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable web applications and data pipelines. Strong background in Python, Django, and cloud infrastructure. Passionate about clean code, developer tooling, and mentoring junior engineers.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Led development of a real-time data ingestion pipeline processing 500k events/day using Kafka and PostgreSQL.
Reduced API response times by 60% by introducing Redis caching and query optimization across the core SaaS platform.
Mentored a team of 4 junior engineers through weekly code reviews and pair programming sessions.
Designed and shipped a self-serve customer reporting dashboard used by 200+ enterprise clients.
Migrated legacy monolith to a modular service architecture, reducing deploy times from 45 minutes to under 5.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained a Django REST API serving 3M monthly active users.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 SSO integration with Google, GitHub, and Okta.
Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and AWS, reducing manual ops work by 80%.
Developed an internal admin tooling suite that cut customer support resolution time by 40%.
Contributed to open-source libraries used by the broader Django community.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Delivered custom web applications for 10+ clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and SaaS verticals.
Built React frontends and Node.js backends, integrating third-party APIs including Stripe and Twilio.
Managed client relationships, project scoping, and delivery end-to-end.
